placementWindows.reason: Lunch starts between 12:00 and 13:00 and finishes by 13:30 in San Francisco, whatever its length: a 45-minute lunch starts by 12:45 (revision 11; until then the latest start was 13:30 and the end unbounded).

preferredInterviewers.reason: Luminai Scheduling SOP: Gabrielle Struckell hosts Welcome; another eligible interviewer only when Gabrielle is unavailable.

Forward Deployed Engineer only (another job has a session of the same name): Ariel Perez Chavez first, then Yun Feng and Keshav Malhotra, and Anisha Tandon only when all three are busy (revision 12, November 5). Interviewer load can still pass Ariel over, and the post says so.

debriefs.reason: Luminai Scheduling SOP: a debrief is scheduled only once the onsite is confirmed, never proposed with the agenda, and may fall before 9am or after 5pm Pacific.

excludedWeekdays.reason: Luminai works from home on Wednesdays, so no onsite is held then (Scheduling SOP).

interviewerLoad.reason: Load wins past a gap of two: among the people free for a session, anyone with two or more interviews that Monday-to-Sunday Pacific week more than the lightest is passed over, even against the preference order, and the post names who was suggested over whom with both counts (revision 12, November 5). Only sessions the person gives feedback on count, so hosting Welcome doesn't (the Grace case); Lunch never counts, though Ashby sometimes marks its feedback required. A last resort is never brought forward by load.

meetingHours.$comment: Assumed, not collected from interviewers. Luminai is San Francisco-based; the default's weekdays are an assumption too. Overrides added 2026-09-29 (revision 3); Sanjay Saraf's 07:00–17:00 Pacific added 2026-10-03 (revision 6), weekdays assumed. The other eight video interviewers under attendance still inherit the Pacific default, which is wrong for them; their hours are still to come.
